sources.title: Qwen3 Embedding 0.6B API - Documentation - DeepInfra
sources.snippet: The Qwen3 Embedding model series is the latest proprietary model of the Qwen family, specifically designed for text embedding and ranking tasks. Building upon the dense foundational models of the Qwen3 series, it provides a comprehensive range of text embeddings and reranking models in various sizes (0.6B, 4B, and 8B).

sources.snippet: AI infrastructure that developers love. Library / Qwen / Qwen3 Embedding 0.6B Qwen3 Embedding 0.6B Qwen3-Embedding-.6B is the lightest model in Qwen's Qwen3 Embedding series: a .6-billion-parameter, 28-layer text embedding model built on Qwen3-.6B-Base, with a 32K-token context, instruction-aware embeddings of up to 1024 dimensions, 100+ languages, and Apache 2.0 weights.
